subject: A small website refinement for HAPPY
body:
Hi HAPPY team,

I appreciate the public website you already have for your business. On the page checked, some images had no alt attribute in the downloaded HTML. Adding useful image descriptions could make those images clearer to people using assistive tools.

I could help you refine your existing website. If useful, we could talk through the options. Would next week suit you?

Kind regards,
Sam
